blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY — The Negros Occidental provincial government is eyeing P8.52 billion in spending for next year, an increase of P900.09 million, or 11.81 percent, from the 2026 level, based on the proposed budget submitted to the Sangguniang Panlalawigan. The spending hike aims to strengthen the delivery of essential public services and to advance priority programs in health, agriculture, infrastructure, economic development, education, and human development under its Abanse Negrense Priority Development Agenda, the provincial government announced on Tuesday.
